ei.title: 8번: The Tragic Eruption of Mount Vesuvius
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been (A)[violent / inactive] for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of (B)[toxic / harmless] gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were (C)[buried / rescued] alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inactive=활동하지 않는 / violent=격렬한 (B) toxic=유독성의 / harmless=무해한 (C) buried=묻힌 / rescued=구조된
det.analysis:
(A) 수백 년간 잠잠했던 화산이므로 inactive(활동하지 않는)가 맞아요. 격렬했다면(violent) '갑자기(suddenly)' 분출했다는 말과 모순돼요.
(B) 폼페이에 도달한 것은 유독가스이므로 toxic(유독성의). harmless(무해한)는 반대예요.
(C) 떠나지 않은 사람들은 재에 산 채로 묻혔으므로 buried(묻힌). rescued(구조된)는 반대예요.
→ 정답: ① inactive — toxic — buried
det.tip: 잠잠한 화산(inactive) → 유독가스(toxic) → 산 채로 묻힘(buried)

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an (A)[ordinary / amazing] rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky (B)[darkened / brightened] and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a (C)[popular / remote] resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) amazing=놀라운 / ordinary=평범한 (B) darkened=어두워졌다 / brightened=밝아졌다 (C) popular=인기 있는 / remote=외딴
det.analysis:
(A) 초당 150만 톤은 amazing(놀라운) 속도예요. ordinary(평범한)는 어색해요.
(B) 화산재가 쏟아져 하늘은 darkened(어두워졌다). brightened(밝아졌다)는 반대예요.
(C) 관광객이 많은 곳이므로 popular(인기 있는) 휴양지. remote(외딴)는 반대예요.
→ 정답: ③ amazing — darkened — popular
det.tip: 놀라운 속도(amazing) → 하늘이 어두워짐(darkened) → 인기 휴양지(popular)

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be (A)[absorbed / expelled] at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to (B)[flow / freeze] around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that (C)[approximately / exactly] 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) expelled=내뿜어진 / absorbed=흡수된 (B) flow=흐르다 / freeze=얼다 (C) approximately=대략 / exactly=정확히
det.analysis:
(A) 바위와 용암이 밖으로 내뿜어졌으므로 expelled. absorbed(흡수된)는 반대예요.
(B) 용암은 흐르기 시작했으므로 flow(흐르다). freeze(얼다)는 반대예요.
(C) 사망자 수는 추정치이므로 approximately(대략). exactly(정확히)는 '~로 여겨진다(is believed)'와 안 맞아요.
→ 정답: ② expelled — flow — approximately

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been ①<u>inactive</u> for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky ②<u>darkened</u> and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of ③<u>fresh</u> gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were ④<u>buried</u> alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ fresh(신선한) → toxic(유독성의): 폼페이에 도달한 가스는 사람을 죽인 유독가스예요.
det.analysis:
① inactive: 수백 년간 잠잠했던 화산 — 적절
② darkened: 재가 쏟아져 하늘이 어두워짐 — 적절
③ fresh → toxic ←정답: '신선한 가스'가 폼페이에 도달? 사람들을 죽게 한 유독가스(toxic)여야 해요.
④ buried: 산 채로 묻힘 — 적절
det.tip: 폼페이에 도달한 가스 = toxic(유독성). fresh(신선한)는 반대

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly ①<u>erupted</u>. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be ②<u>attracted</u> at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a ③<u>popular</u> resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people ④<u>died</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② attracted(끌어당겨진) → expelled(내뿜어진): 바위와 용암은 화산 밖으로 내뿜어졌어요.
det.analysis:
① erupted: 화산이 갑자기 분출함 — 적절
② attracted → expelled ←정답: 바위와 용암이 '끌어당겨졌다'? 분출은 밖으로 내뿜는(expelled) 것이에요.
③ popular: 관광객 많은 인기 휴양지 — 적절
④ died: 약 16,000명이 사망 — 적절

The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an ①<u>amazing</u> rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The lava started to ②<u>flow</u> around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular ③<u>resort</u> spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ precisely(정확히) → approximately(대략): 사망자 수는 '여겨지는(is believed)' 추정치예요.
det.analysis:
① amazing: 초당 150만 톤의 놀라운 속도 — 적절
② flow: 용암이 흐르기 시작 — 적절
③ resort: 인기 휴양지 — 적절
④ precisely → approximately ←정답: '정확히 16,000명'이라 하면 추정(is believed)과 모순돼요. 대략(approximately)이 맞아요.

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was a popular resort spot, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were __________ in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: rescued quickly=빠르게 구조된 / carried away=옮겨진 / kept safe=안전하게 보호된 / buried alive=산 채로 묻힌
det.analysis:
① rescued quickly: 빠르게 구조? 떠나지 않은 사람들의 비극적 결말과 반대
② carried away: 옮겨진? 재와 바위 속 상황과 안 맞음
③ kept safe: 안전하게 보호? 반대
④ buried alive: 떠나지 않은 사람들은 바위와 재 속에 산 채로 묻힘 ←정답
det.tip: did not leave(떠나지 않음) → buried alive(산 채로 묻힘)

questions.passage: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in Italy that had been inactive for hundreds of years until August 24, 79 A.D., when it suddenly erupted. The eruption began in the morning, as rock and lava began to be expelled at an amazing rate of 1.5 million tons per second. The sky darkened and about six inches of ash fell to the ground each hour. The lava started to flow around midnight, and the next morning a cloud of toxic gas reached Pompeii, where around 20,000 people lived. At the time, the region was __________, with many tourists. Most of the people who did not leave at the start of the eruption were buried alive in rock and ash. In the end, it is believed that approximately 16,000 people died.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a quiet fishing village=조용한 어촌 / an abandoned wasteland=버려진 황무지 / a popular resort spot=인기 있는 휴양지 / a busy industrial city=분주한 공업 도시
det.analysis:
① a quiet fishing village: 조용한 어촌? 많은 관광객과 안 맞음
② an abandoned wasteland: 버려진 황무지? 반대
③ a popular resort spot: 많은 관광객이 찾는 인기 휴양지 ←정답
④ a busy industrial city: 공업 도시? 관광과 안 맞음
det.tip: with many tourists(많은 관광객) → a popular resort spot(인기 휴양지)
